summary: Session 2 closed Finding #2 (manifest is not a navigation index) with an additive harvester-schema v1.0 -> v1.1 bump and folded in the three schema-vs-typed-record drift fixes Session 1 surfaced. New v1.1 schema (docs/test-cases/harvester-schema.v1.1.json): adds optional top-level Documentation (Url + SchemaVersion) + FileMap (per-category Count + Glob) for binary-only consumer navigation; renames RelationshipDefinition Table/ForeignTable -> ParentTable/ChildTable + inner Fields Name/ForeignName -> ParentField/ChildField (matches the long-shipping RelationshipMetadata typed record); renames TableIndex Primary/Unique/Foreign -> IsPrimary/IsUnique/IsRequired and switches Fields items from string to IndexField objects (matches the TableIndex typed record); replaces HarvestedItem oneOf with allOf+if/then/else keyed on ItemKind (cleaner branch selection); adds 'LateBound' to Classification.Purity enum (corrective for the actual top-level failure — ClassificationCategory.ToString() emits LateBound but the v1.0 schema omitted it; this was the real root cause of the 1099-error cascade Session 1 attributed to oneOf). New C# records (AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Manifest/Navigation.cs): DocumentationPointer, FileMap, FileMapEntry. DatabaseManifest bumped SchemaVersion -> '1.1' via new SchemaVersionLiteral const (CLI sources from this); added nullable Documentation/FileMap props so existing test surfaces keep compiling. DatabaseManifestAggregator.Build gains optional documentation + fileMap trailing params. Pipeline.cs EmitManifestArtifacts now computes FileMap from in-memory collection counts AFTER per-object ir/ emission (FileMap.<X>.Count == manifest.<X>.Length by construction), builds DocumentationPointer with canonical https://github.com/darndestdabbler/dabbler-access-harvester/blob/main/docs/harvester/interpretation-guide.md URL + schema version, and writes a static READ-ME-FIRST.md (string.Join('\n', ...) — no timestamps, byte-identical across runs) at <baseDir>/READ-ME-FIRST.md per the human-ratified entry-point decision (BOTH manifest + README). CLI: AccessHarvester.Cli.csproj now bundles BOTH harvester-schema.v1.0.json and v1.1.json as embedded resources; RunValidate performs per-document schema dispatch (reads $.SchemaVersion, caches a SchemaValidator per version, validates against the dispatched schema) — this addresses the R1 verifier's Major finding that the additive backward-compat policy was overstated when SchemaVersion was const '1.1'. --json-status envelope gains SupportedSchemaVersions + PerManifestSchemaVersion[]. tmp/build-golden-corpus updated to copy READ-ME-FIRST.md from staging into the golden snapshot (R1 verifier Minor finding). New tests: ManifestCompletenessTests.Manifest_FileMap_counts_and_globs_match_arrays_and_on_disk (Theory: HHC + Northwind) pins FileMap.<X>.Count == manifest.<X>.Length == count of on-disk glob matches; ManifestSchemaConformanceTests.V1_0_Shaped_SmokeFixture_ValidatesAgainstSchema; ManifestSchemaConformanceTests.PipelineRun_EmitsReadMeFirstAlongsideManifest; CliValidateTests.Validate_V1_0_Manifest_DispatchesToV1_0_Schema_AndReturnsZero; CliValidateTests.Validate_Mixed_V1_0_And_V1_1_Manifests_BothDispatchedAndPass. Un-skipped: ManifestSchemaConformanceTests.HomeHealthCare_FullRun_ManifestValidatesAgainstSchema (Session 1 had Skip'd this; now passes against v1.1). Updated: every test that hard-coded SchemaVersion '1.0' or schema-v1.0.json path (DatabaseManifestAggregatorTests, CliBootstrapTests, CliRunTests, CliValidateTests, EndToEndPipelineTests, SchemaValidatorTests, PredicateNodeRoundTripTests, SchemaDocGeneratorTests, RepoPaths.SchemaFile, examples/northwind-output.json) -> '1.1'. TestCaseFixtureConformanceTests intentionally pinned at v1.0 (validates the v0->v1 migration fixture corpus). Both samples/GoldenOutput/{HomeHealthCare,NorthwindDevEdition} regenerated via tmp/build-golden-corpus from fresh CLI runs (+ READ-ME-FIRST.md now committed). Determinism gate green: two normalized Pipeline.Run invocations against HomeHealthCare.accdb are byte-identical. Production validate exits 0 on both fresh fixtures against v1.1 schema. dotnet build = 0 errors / pre-existing CA1416 + NU1903 warnings only. dotnet test sequential = 2109 passed, 2 skipped (pre-existing synthetic-fixture skips), 0 failed (Integration: 55 / 0 / 0 — up from 53 with dispatch tests). R1 cross-provider verification by gpt-5-4 returned ISSUES_FOUND (1 Major + 1 Minor); both fixed in-session; R2 verification by gpt-5-4 returned VERIFIED with empty issues array. Total Session 2 routed cost $0.1847 (gemini-pro architecture $0.05005 — opus@max timed out twice, fell back via task_type=planning + max_tier=2; R1 gpt-5-4 session-verification $0.11534; R2 gpt-5-4 session-verification $0.01931).
